about-us.title: About Us
about-us.description: About SarkariLinks and how our independent notice portal works.

sections.heading: A practical place to find your next step
sections.text: SarkariLinks brings published government job, examination, admission and certificate-verification notices together with useful application tools. We are an independent information portal, not a government department or recruiting authority.

sections.heading: How notices are published
sections.text: Our content workflow requires official source links and independent editorial review before publication. Uploaded advertisements and OCR suggestions are reviewed before they become published notices. Readers should confirm dates, eligibility and instructions on the issuing authority's website.

sections.heading: Tools and your workspace
sections.text: You can browse notices without an account. An account adds saved jobs, preferences and private resume saves. Image conversion, compression, text extraction and portrait background removal use local browser processing where supported.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: How the current SarkariLinks application handles account details, files and browser storage.

sections.heading: Account information
sections.text: Registration stores your name, email address and a hashed password. Profile preferences, job bookmarks and resumes explicitly saved to your account are stored on our server and protected by account access controls.

sections.heading: Files and processing
sections.text: Public browser image, PDF, OCR and portrait tools process source files locally. Resume fields are sent to the server when you choose Save to my account. Staff advertisement uploads are stored privately and processed on the server. Media download links are sent to a server worker; outputs are private and expire one hour after submission, with scheduled cleanup.

sections.heading: Cookies and device storage
sections.text: Session and CSRF cookies support login and request security. Recent-tool history stores up to four tool identifiers in localStorage, not file contents or form inputs. Use Clear recent tools on the homepage to remove that history. Clearing session cookies signs you out.

sections.heading: External services and retention
sections.text: Official source links and media platforms have their own privacy practices. No advertising or analytics integration has been configured by this release. Account records and saved content remain stored until removed; automated account deletion and data export are not yet available. Hosting logs, backups, retention schedules and the responsible operator's contact details must be confirmed before this draft is adopted.

sections.heading: Your controls
sections.text: You can update profile preferences, remove job bookmarks and delete your saved resume from your account tools. Do not submit identity documents or sensitive personal information through ordinary support messages.

terms-of-use.title: Terms of Use
terms-of-use.description: Draft terms for using SarkariLinks notices, accounts and tools.

sections.heading: Using the information
sections.text: Use this portal as an information aid. The issuing authority's original notice determines eligibility, fees, dates and application requirements. SarkariLinks does not submit government applications, issue certificates or guarantee selection.

sections.heading: Accounts and responsible use
sections.text: Keep your login details secure and provide information you are entitled to use. Do not attempt to access another person's account, disrupt services, bypass access controls or submit malicious files.

sections.heading: Tools and uploaded material
sections.text: Use only files and media that you own or are authorized to process. Check OCR, calculations, converted files and resume output before relying on them. Media availability and tool compatibility vary; these tools do not bypass private or restricted sources.

sections.heading: Fees and commercial offers
sections.text: The current public utilities and notice browsing are free. We do not collect government application fees. Any future optional paid service must disclose its price and applicable terms separately.

sections.heading: Operator review
sections.text: These draft terms describe current product behavior. The site operator must confirm business identity, support arrangements and applicable legal terms before adopting them for public operation.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.description: Important limits of government-notice summaries and application tools.

sections.heading: Independent information service
sections.text: SarkariLinks is not affiliated with UPSC, SSC, IBPS, Railway Recruitment Boards or other issuing authorities. Organization names identify the subjects of notices; they do not imply endorsement.

sections.heading: Confirm with the official source
sections.text: Notices may be corrected, postponed or withdrawn by their issuing authorities. Always open the official source linked on a notice and check the latest instructions before applying or paying any fee.

sections.heading: Certificate verification
sections.text: Certificate Verification lists official notices and guidance. We do not verify identity, authenticate certificates, issue credentials or request your certificate numbers on these listing pages. Complete verification only through the issuing authority's official process.

sections.heading: Tool output
sections.text: OCR and AI processing can make mistakes. Review extracted text, image quality, calculations and resume content. External websites and media sources operate independently of this portal.

contact-us.title: Contact Us
contact-us.description: Help with notices, corrections and SarkariLinks account questions.

sections.heading: Corrections and questions
sections.text: For a notice correction, include the SarkariLinks page URL, the official source URL and a short explanation of the issue. For a tool problem, include the tool name, browser and error message; do not send passwords or private documents.

sections.heading: Application and certificate queries
sections.text: Contact the issuing authority through the official source page for application status, payment problems, exam results or certificate verification. SarkariLinks cannot access those authority systems.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Answers about notices, admissions, certificate verification, accounts and tools.

sections.heading: Is SarkariLinks a government website?
sections.text: No. It is an independent information portal. Each published notice links to its official source.

sections.heading: Do I need an account?
sections.text: No account is needed to browse notices or use the browser tools. Sign in to save jobs, set preferences, save a resume or request a supported media download.

sections.heading: Where do I apply for admission?
sections.text: Open an admission notice and follow its official source link. Confirm eligibility, deadlines and fees with the institution or issuing authority.

sections.heading: Can I verify my certificate here?
sections.text: This section provides published verification notices and instructions. Actual certificate checks happen through the issuing authority's official system.

sections.heading: Why is a category empty?
sections.text: Only published notices in the selected language appear. Editors must review a notice before it is listed; missing entries are not filled with invented updates.

sections.heading: Can I switch to Hindi?
sections.text: Choose Hindi in listing filters or the homepage notice board. Hindi notices appear when a corresponding version has been published.

sections.heading: Are my image and PDF files uploaded?
sections.text: Public browser image and OCR tools process source files locally. Staff advertisement extraction and media downloads use the server. Resume fields are uploaded only when explicitly saved to an account.

sections.heading: How do I return to saved work?
sections.text: Open My dashboard for saved jobs and preferences. The homepage also shows recent tools; Clear recent tools removes their names from this device.
